title: Personal Gmail addresses exposed in public-repo commit author metadata
category: CWE-359 Exposure of Private Personal Information
remediation: Review-only. moein.fatehi@gmail.com and hafezsecure@gmail.com appear as commit author/committer identities across history of this public repo. No file content is affected. Consider making future commits under a role or noreply identity; rewriting existing history is disruptive and not recommended for this low-impact item. Founder decision.

title: Static analysis (SAST) is not part of the local gate
remediation: Already self-identified and planned in docs/handbook-sync.md (drift row, target 2026-11-30): copy the company static-analysis rule files, run the first scan of scripts/, triage, then add the step to the gate. The gate otherwise validates data, checks docs, audits dependencies and scans secrets. Deviation from the company delivery-pipeline rule; low risk given the tiny, no-runtime script surface.
